$\int_L(1+2xy)dx+x^2dy$，$L$ 为从点 $(1,0)$ 到点 $(-1,0)$ 的上半椭圆弧 $x^2+2y^2=1\ (y\ge0)$，其计算结果为（ ） $-2$ $1$ $\frac43$ $2$ 解：由 $L:\begin{cases}x=\cos\theta\\y=-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta\end{cases}\quad \theta:0\to\pi$，得

$$\int_L(1+2xy)dx+x^2dy$$

$$=\int_0^\pi\left[1+2\cos\theta\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta\right)\right](-\sin\theta)+\cos^2\theta\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cos\theta\,d\theta$$

$$=-\int_0^\pi\sin\theta\,d\theta-\sqrt{2}\int_0^\pi\sin^2\theta\cos\theta\,d\theta+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\int_0^\pi\cos^3\theta\,d\theta$$

$$=\left.\cos\theta\right|_0^\pi+\sqrt{2}\int_0^\pi\sin^2\theta\,d\sin\theta+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\int_0^\pi(1-\sin^2\theta)\,d\sin\theta$$

$$=-2+\left.\sqrt{2}\frac{\sin^3\theta}{3}\right|_0^\pi+\left.\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\left(\sin\theta-\frac{\sin^3\theta}{3}\right)\right|_0^\pi$$

$$=-2-0+0=-2$$
